chapter: Early recordings and arrival in New York
title: Billie Holiday, Ella Logan and the origins of the 'Loch Lomond' idea
summary: Hughes asks if other singers' folk-song swings inspired it; Maxine discusses Ella Logan and press coverage in DownBeat.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
